tasting_notes: Blend of unaged and 6-year agricole Clément rums aged with orange peels in 250L oak casks for a year. Orange/mandarin zest, white chocolate, vanilla, acacia honey, black pepper.
J.M aged rhum with bitter orange zest, sugarcane syrup, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg maceration. AOC Martinique agricole liqueur.
